# Registry contract fixture

Generated by `Nanobug-Plugin-Marketplace/tests/test_registry.py` through the production `build_catalog` function. The ZIP uses deterministic timestamps; no plugin code executes in this fixture.

To regenerate, set `NANOBUG_CONTRACT_FIXTURE` to this absolute directory, then run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` in the marketplace repository (Python 3.11+). Review both the JSON and ZIP digest changes together. Client tests change only the network endpoint to loopback.
